features.name: Excise taxes framework
features.description: A configurable framework for calculating and managing excise taxes and duties across multiple excise types including plastic tax, sugar tax, alcohol, cigarettes, petrol, and cannabis.
caveats: excise taxes is independent app and can be removed from the system
only supports fixed rate excise duty calculations, not percentage-based
cannot combine plastic excise tax with other excise tax types

features.name: Excise journal with multiple calculation models
features.description: An excise journal that supports multiple calculation models including CBAM, EPR, and configurable excise tax types. Users can select specific excise types and configure how they are calculated.
caveats: CBAM and EPR are independent calculations and cannot be combined with regular excise taxes
Different excise types require separate configuration

features.name: Tax bases configuration
features.description: Six different tax base models for calculating excise taxes: weight, volume, quantity, sugar content, pure alcohol content, and active content.
caveats: Selection of tax base is mandatory for each excise tax type

features.name: Entry permissions and source types
features.description: Configurable entry permissions to specify which transaction types contribute to excise tax calculation: purchase, positive adjustment, output, assembly output, sales, or negative adjustment.
caveats: Different excise types may require different entry permission configurations

features.name: Excise duty rates on items and fixed assets
features.description: Configuration of fixed excise duty rates that can be applied to items or fixed assets with effective from dates. Supports rare scenarios where fixed assets are subject to excise taxation.
caveats: Only fixed rate calculation is supported, not percentage-based
Fixed asset excise duties are rare scenarios

features.name: Excise quantity configuration on items
features.description: Ability to specify excise quantity on item master data to track the specific quantity subject to excise tax separately from total item weight or volume.
caveats: Excise quantity uses separate unit of measure from item's standard unit

features.name: Excise journal calculation workflow
features.description: Automated workflow that identifies excise types, searches for relevant entries, applies configured tax bases and rates, then generates excise transaction entries.

features.name: Excise transaction logs
features.description: Transaction log page that records all excise tax calculations including type, source, amount, and related document information.
caveats: No specific report available yet for excise transaction logs
Data can be exported to Excel

features.name: Parallel CBAM and EPR with excise taxes
features.description: Ability to run CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism) and EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility) calculations in parallel with excise tax calculations on the same item.
caveats: CBAM and EPR work in parallel but cannot be combined with other excise tax types on the same item
Requires separate configuration on sustainability fast tab

features.name: Dynamic reporting captions for excise types
features.description: Configurable reporting captions for excise tax types that display on the excise journal, showing the specific tax type name in brackets (e.g., 'plastic tax', 'alcohol excise duty').

quotes.text: excise taxes framework officially has been delivered in 2025 wave release wave two. But in this moment, we had only framework and two options
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that the core framework is GA since wave 2, and this wave 1 extends it with additional functionality beyond CBAM and EPR.

quotes.text: So, now we already have them inside from previous wave, but in this wave, we extended it to much more options. So, what does
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the scope of 2026 wave 1 enhancement - expanding from just CBAM and EPR to fully configurable excise tax types.

quotes.text: You have different models, six different models, how you will calculate and what what will be used as a calculation for this excise taxes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the specific calculation models available (weight, volume, quantity, sugar content, pure alcohol content, active content) for tax base configuration.

quotes.text: This is not percent because they are not we do not use as a percentage on some specific value. This is let's say limitation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes a key limitation - only fixed rates are supported, not percentage-based excise duty calculations.

quotes.text: But, what you cannot you cannot combine uh plastic excise tax with some other excise taxes here from different types. This is not possible.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies an important constraint - different excise tax types cannot be combined on the same item, though CBAM/EPR can run in parallel.

quotes.text: So, that means if you are using plastic tax calculation, it will not exclude completely EPR calculation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms that EPR and plastic excise tax can be calculated side by side, which corrects a common misunderstanding.

quotes.text: Currently, we do not have any specific report for um showing, so you can export in Excel, but plan is to continue invest invest
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates that specialized reporting for excise transaction logs is planned but not yet delivered, currently only Excel export is available.

disclaimers.text: plan is to continue invest into this direction and this functionality, so we will see what will be next delivered
